name: Toast Stack
description: A stacked toaster with a useToasts hook: toasts deal in like cards, fan out on hover, swipe away, pause while read and resolve promises in place. Greyscale.

props.name: strategy
props.description: Pin the stack to the viewport, or keep it inside the nearest positioned parent.

props.name: position
props.description: Where the stack sits from 640px up. Below that it spans the bottom edge.

props.name: accent
props.description: The one accent: the action button (its text is black or white by luminance).

props.name: theme
props.description: Dark raised cards or white cards; success and error keep their semantic green and red.

props.name: hotkey
props.description: Alt plus this key focuses the newest toast.

props.name: useToasts()
props.type: { toasts, toast, success, error, info, promise, dismiss }
props.description: The live list plus creators. Each creator takes (title, { description, action, duration }) and returns an id.

props.name: toast
props.description: The same creators, callable outside React.

props.name: promise(p, messages)
props.description: Shows a loading toast that turns into success or error in place when the promise settles.
